sentences.text: [Order of the Court was made by A.D.JAGADISH CHANDIRA, J.]

The present Writ Petition is filed by the wife of the convict challenging the impugned order passed by the respondent, dated 21.05.2024 and consequently, to direct the respondent to grant Ordinary Leave to the petitioner's husband namely Rameshkumar, S/o.Venkadasubbu (CP No.1107), Central Prison, Madurai.

2. It is the case of the petitioner that the petitioner's husband namely Rmaeshkumar,
S/o.Venkadasubbu (CP No.1107) have been convicted in C.C.No. 33 of 2013 on the file of the Special Court under TNPID cases, Madurai on 03.03.2022 for the offence under Sections 120(B), 406, 420,
468, 471 of IPC and section 5 of TNPID Act, Section 5 of TNPID Act for 10 years Rigorous Imprisonment and fine of Rs.1,00,000/- in default to undergo one year Simple Imprisonment and fine of Rs.1,00,000/- in default to undergo one year Simple Imprisonment, Section 406 of IPC for 3 years Rigorous Imprisonment and fine of ____________ https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Rs.10,000/- in default to undergo one year Simple Imprisonment, Section 420 of IPC for 7 years Rigorous Imprisonment and fine of Rs.10,000/- in defualt to undergo one year Simple Imprisonment, Section 468 of IPC for 7 years Rigorous Imprisonment and fine of Rs.10,000/- in default to undergo one year Simple Imprisonment and Section 471 of IPC one year Simple Imprisonment and Section 471 of IPC for 7 years Rigorous Imprisonment and fine of Rs.10,000/- in default to undergo one year Simple Imprisonment.

Aggrieved against the said conviction and sentence the petitioner's husband has preferred an appeal before this Court in Crl.A(MD)No.260 of 2022 and the same was ended in conviction on 12.03.2024, the order copy is awaited and yet to be uploaded.
3. The petitioner's child namely Nandabalaji was suffering from SUPRAVENTRICULAR TACHYCARDIA which means an irregularly fast or erratic heartbeat and they were takiing treatment since his birth.

He has studying in 11th standard in John Paul Higher Secondary School,
at Dindigul.

entities.text:

sentences.text: Therefore, the petitioner has sent a representation to the respondent on 01.05.2024 seeking ordinary leave to her husband.

The respondent had rejected the same and passed the impugned order No.I/18986/2024, dated 21.05.2024 stating that appeal is ____________ https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis pending before this Court and hence, there is no possibility of granting leave.
Challenging the said rejection order, the petitioner has filed the present writ petition on the ground that the appeal has already been disposed of by this Court on 12.03.2024.

4. The learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent would submit that the representation for Ordinary Leave has been rejected on the ground that the appeal is pending,
however, on verification now it is seen that the appeal has been disposed of by this Court on 12.03.2024 and it is stated that the order copy is yet to be issued and uploaded.
E-Court Services details also produced before this Court.

5. Heard the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent and perused the materials available on record.
6.
It is seen from the records that the appeal has been disposed of and now there is no appeal p e n d i n g a n d h e n c e , t h e o r d e r o f r e j e c t i o n c a n n o t b e _
_ _ _ https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis sustained.
The impugned order of rejection of representation for Shanmugapriya vs The Superintendent on 13 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/81650798/
2 ordinary leave on the ground of pending of appeal stands set aside.

Therefore, this Court directs the respondent to reconsider the request of the petitioner, if he is otherwise eligible for ordinary leave,
without awaiting for the copy of the judgement and pass orders on merits and in accordance with law within a period of one (1) week from today.
7.
With the above directions, this writ petition is disposed of.
No costs.

[A.D.J.C., J.] [K.R.S., J.
